title: Jellyfish waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell / dome of jellyfish -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#c44dff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='30' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#e8b3ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Bell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#e8b3ff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Frilly bottom edge of bell -->
  <path d='M20 38 Q25 46 30 38 Q35 46 40 38 Q45 46 50 38 Q55 46 60 38 Q65 46 70 38 Q75 46 80 38' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ee8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Tentacles hanging down -->
  <path d='M30 40 Q26 55 30 68 Q32 75 28 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff77d4' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 40 Q38 58 42 70 Q44 80 40 86' fill='none' stroke='#ff77d4' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 40 Q50 60 48 72 Q46 82 50 88' fill='none' stroke='#ff77d4' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 40 Q62 58 58 70 Q56 80 60 86' fill='none' stroke='#ff77d4' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 40 Q74 55 70 68 Q68 75 72 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff77d4' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Waving arm / tentacle raised to the right -->
  <path d='M78 34 Q86 28 90 20 Q92 16 90 14' fill='none' stroke='#ff77d4' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Hand / tip of waving tentacle -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='13' r='4' fill='#ffd1f0'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='13' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ee8' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Cute face on the bell -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='36' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3d1a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='36' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3d1a5c'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q50 47 56 42' fill='none' stroke='#3d1a5c' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='41' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ee8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='41' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ee8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
